tasks-for-the-configuration-output-of-a-.text: Tasks for the configuration output of a fold.
Issue 799. Grouped by slice of the plan. A task is checked only after the ticket owner accepts its slice.

slice-configuration-is-named-by-the-desc.text: Slice: configuration is named by the description.

[ ] failing-checks-first: checks that fail on the base — a stand-in application whose configuration output is not skipped, the open datum recognition cases, the observation judge and refusal census expecting absence.
[ ] description-names-configuration: the application description gains the question and discovery consults it.
[ ] open-datum-answers: the open datum description answers it from the request address and the configuration decoding.
[ ] consumers-follow: the observation judge, the refusal census, the retained receipts and the pages that listed the skip.
[ ] hosted-forms-pass: lint, the unit suites, documentation under the runner's bare path and the hosted devnet refusal jobs.
